# @rnw-community/shared

> Generic TypeScript type guards, utility functions, and utility types shared across the rnw-community packages. Zero
> runtime dependencies.

Prefer these primitives over inline checks and ad-hoc helpers: `isDefined` instead of null/undefined comparisons,
`emptyFn` as the canonical no-op, `wait(ms)` for Promise-based sleep, and `getErrorMessage` in catch blocks.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Index of all type guards, utils, and types with links to per-entity docs.

## API reference

- [`isDefined`](readme.md#type-guards): Narrows away `null` and `undefined`.
- [`isError`](readme.md#type-guards): `instanceof Error` check narrowing to `Error`.
- [`isObject`](readme.md#type-guards): Non-null, non-array `object` check.
- [`isPromise`](readme.md#type-guards): Detects a `Promise` or any thenable per the Promises/A+ resolution procedure.
- [`isRecord`](readme.md#type-guards): Non-array object narrowed to `Record<PropertyKey, unknown>` so it is safe to index by key.
- [`isArray`](readme.md#type-guards): Defined-and-`Array.isArray` check that intersects the input type with `readonly unknown[]`.
- [`isEmptyArray`](readme.md#type-guards): Array with zero elements.
- [`isNotEmptyArray`](readme.md#type-guards): Array with at least one element, narrowed to a non-empty tuple of the element type.
- [`isNotEmptyArrayOf`](readme.md#type-guards): Non-empty array whose every item passes the supplied guard.
- [`isString`](readme.md#type-guards): `typeof value === 'string'` check.
- [`isEmptyString`](readme.md#type-guards): String with zero length.
- [`isNotEmptyString`](readme.md#type-guards): String with at least one character.
- [`isDecimalMonetaryValue`](readme.md#type-guards): Decimal-formatted numeric string such as a currency amount (`-12.50`).
- [`isNumber`](readme.md#type-guards): `typeof value === 'number'` check.
- [`isPositiveNumber`](readme.md#type-guards): Number greater than zero.
- [`isBoolean`](readme.md#type-guards): `typeof value === 'boolean'` check.
- [`getErrorMessage`](readme.md#utils): Type-safe `.message` of an `Error`, or a fallback (default `''`) for anything else.
- [`emptyFn`](readme.md#utils): Canonical no-op function, useful as a default callback value.
- [`cs`](readme.md#utils): Conditional styling helper returning the true style, the false style, or `{}`.
- [`getDefined`](readme.md#utils): Returns the value when defined, otherwise the result of a lazy default function.
- [`wait`](readme.md#utils): Promise-based sleep via `setTimeout`.
- [`ClassType`](readme.md#types): Constructable class type `new (...args) => T`.
- [`AbstractConstructor`](readme.md#types): Abstract constructor type `abstract new (...args) => T`.
- [`Maybe`](readme.md#types): `T | null`.
- [`OnEventFn`](readme.md#types): Single-event callback `(event: T) => R`.
- [`EmptyFn`](readme.md#types): `(...args: any[]) => void` callback type.
- [`AnyFn`](readme.md#types): Generic function constraint `(...args: any) => any`.
- [`Enum`](readme.md#types): Enum-like `Record<string, D>`.
- [`IsNotEmptyArray`](readme.md#types): Mutable tuple with at least one element `[T, ...T[]]`.
- [`ReadonlyIsNotEmptyArray`](readme.md#types): Readonly tuple with at least one element.
- [`MethodDecoratorType`](readme.md#types): Typed method-decorator signature over a method type `K`.
